item.title: Horace Panter’s “Ghost Town” 1971 Fender Precision Heads to Auction
item.description: Horace Panter’s 1971 Fender Precision, used to record The Specials’ “Ghost Town,” is headed to auction with an estimated £10K–£20K sale price.

item.title: Paul McCartney’s "Man on the Run" Explores His Post-Beatles Reinvention — Now Streaming on Amazon Prime
item.description: Paul McCartney’s new documentary "Man on the Run" explores his life and career in the 1970s after The Beatles, featuring new interviews and rare archival footage.

item.title: Hear Joe Dart Lock In on Bass in Vulfmon’s “Rocco Darto Cato”
item.description: Joe Dart leads from the first note on “Rocco Darto Cato,” delivering classic P bass tone as Louis Cato and Cory Wong round out the groove.

item.title: Dumpstaphunk Announces 2026 “Put It In Tha Dumpsta” Tour, Including Sly & The Family Stone Tribute
item.description: Dumpstaphunk is hitting the road in 2026 with the “Put It In Tha Dumpsta” tour, featuring festival stops, hometown Jazz Fest shows, and a special Sly & The Family Stone tribute in Ohio.

item.title: Yorkville Sound Lands Exclusive Canadian Distribution Deals With Aguilar, Spector, and Darkglass
item.description: Yorkville Sound announces exclusive Canadian distribution partnerships with Aguilar, Spector, and Darkglass, expanding access to top-tier bass gear across Canada.

item.title: Robert Trujillo, Zakk Wylde Back Robbie Williams in Ozzy Osbourne’s “No More Tears” Tribute
item.description: The 2026 BRIT Awards close with an Ozzy Osbourne tribute as Robbie Williams takes the mic and Robert Trujillo delivers the thunder on “No More Tears.”

item.title: The Week in Bass: Historic Jazz Bass Drama, Prog-Jazz Heat, and Boutique Craftsmanship
item.description: Bootsy Collins’ 1969 Fender Jazz Bass is back on the market, the Spirit Fingers Trio delivers a blazing performance, and Bryant Trenier’s upright-inspired fretless acoustic steals the spotlight. Catch up on this week’s biggest bass stories.

item.title: February 2026’s Biggest Bass Gear Stories: The Top 10
item.description: February brought a wave of new bass gear as we explored NAMM 2026 highlights. Here are the 10 most-read bass gear stories on No Treble for February 2026.

item.title: Federico Malaman Trio Brings Warmth and Melody to “Song for Marco”
item.description: A new live performance from Federico Malaman’s trio highlights “Song for Marco,” with melodic piano and a wide, polished bass tone throughout.

item.title: The Carbonetti Guitars "Bowery" Bass Is What Happens When Vintage DNA Gets Reimagined
item.description: Built in Brooklyn, the Carbonetti Bowery Bass pairs mahogany warmth, custom humbuckers, and striking turquoise fret markers.
